protocol_metadata.probability_calibration_protocol: UNAVAILABLE_STAGE1_SCOPE: Evaluates uncalibrated tree-ensemble voting probabilities. Post-hoc probability calibration metrics are marked as UNAVAILABLE because internal random-fold calibration does NOT establish valid calibration on out-of-scaffold chemotypes, and nested scaffold-grouped calibration is outside Stage 1 scope (STAGE1_CALIBRATION_SCOPE_NOTE).
protocol_metadata.features: Morgan circular fingerprints (radius=2, n_bits=2048, binary int8)

scientific_caveats: Folds and seeds reuse the same dataset (N=1,461, 112 positives) and are NOT independent biological cohorts.
Repeated cross-validation quantifies partition variance, not external biological validity.
This model is an exploratory research and educational prioritization tool, not a validated clinical safety determination.
High ROC-AUC does not guarantee reliable detection of toxicity on novel chemotypes at specific operational thresholds.

roc_auc.limitations_note: Scaffold-cluster block bootstrap resamples scaffold clusters with replacement to account for within-scaffold dependence. When positive events are concentrated in a small number of scaffold clusters, bootstrap replicates may exhibit discrete jumps or draw zero positives (tracked via n_invalid_replicates); cluster bootstrap CIs are not guaranteed to be wider than naive molecule-level bootstrap CIs.
